name: sqlite-browser-web
description: Dependency-free browser UI for opening, inspecting and editing SQLite databases on the Client filesystem or uploaded from the browser.

common-all.notes: Pure Python source bundle. Requires only the Client Python standard library with sqlite3 support.

sqlite-browser-web.description: Run the dependency-free SQLite browser with the Python runtime used by the Client.

modules.name: sqlite-browser-web
modules.description: Starts a persistent SQLite browser. Choose a Client-side database or upload one after opening the Web UI.

params.name: instance_name
params.label: Instance Name
params.description: Unique name for this browser instance. It controls log, state and uploaded-file isolation.

params.name: address
params.label: Listen Address
params.description: HTTP listen address. Use 127.0.0.1 when remote network access is not required.

params.name: port
params.label: Listen Port
params.description: HTTP port for the SQLite browser.

params.name: page_size
params.label: Rows Per Page
params.description: Number of rows shown per table page.

params.name: max_upload_mb
params.label: Max Upload (MiB)
params.description: Maximum SQLite database size accepted by browser upload.
